string.text: Massacre
This carnage... You killed twenty opponents, one by one, without dying!
Paranoiac
No one was able to get you: they can't compete with such a careful and prudent opponent. You have never died during the game and earned more than fifteen points!
Overwhelming Superiority
The enemy was begging for a defeat: you have won and with twice as much points as their best fighter.
Blitzkrieg
Your audacious plan to capture an artefact was an instant success! You have snatched their artefact and scored in less than three minutes since the start of the game.
Perfect Victory
You did not give the opponent the slightest chance to win! They could not get even a single artefact.
Round Champion
You won all the awards: most enemies killed, most artefacts captures, least death... Keep it up!
Rabies
The steel combat knife is a part of your own body. You disembowelled three enemies in under three minutes!
«Achilles' Heel»
Even the most experienced opponent has a vulnerability. You found his "Achilles heel", and shot him with your pistol... straight in the eye.
I Can Dodge Bullets
What, you brush off enemy bullets? You pass through the lethal rain easily, with a knife in your hand and a single goal - facing the enemy.
Bloody Harvest
What a humiliation for the enemy! Killed ten times, he was never able to get you! He'd better take it as a signal to practice more, rather than unnecessary cruelty.
Grim Reaper
One shot and two kills? You are Death's embodiment!
Two Shots - Two Corpses
You are instant death to the enemy. To take down two enemies, one after another? Not bad, not bad ...
Careerist
You grasped the essence of the stalker crafts, breaking into the ranks of legendary stalkers.
Man Opener
You have opened an exoskeleton with a knife? Wow! Seems like you're not afraid of setting unusual goals for yourself - and achieving them by any means necessary.
Die Hard
They thought they could get you, hah! No dice! You stopped two steps from oblivion but still managed to pull through.
Unrestrained Fury
You just rake them with a steady stream of bullets. Five enemies in five seconds ... impressive!
Ophthalmologist
It seems that the saying "hit the nail on the head" is about you. To kill the enemy twice in such a way, without dying - wow!
Lightning Reflexes
They can wait for you around the corner, but they will never be a serious obstacle: even on the run you are able to hit them straight in the eyes.
Stopping The Fugitive
Let the enemy save himself, let him run like the wind! He might be an Olympic sprinting champion, but your bullet is still faster.
Sniper Elite
Three opponents, a sniper rifle and your skills? They will need three body bags...
Ambassador of Peace
Let the enemy remain barbarians. You were able to show them that victory does not always entail weapon use.
Perfect Shot
As a sniper, you'll easily hit bullseye at over one hundred twenty meters!
Souvenirs
The enemy killed you. But imagine his surprise, when next to your backpack he found a live grenade!
Raider
They killed your comrades and deserved your wrath. Three enemy corpses for three murdered allies are still quite a lenient sentence.
Seraphim
You are a guardian angel associated with the artefact. After killing the enemies who tried to intercept the carrier twice, you've also saved his life on top of that.
Saved Dignity
You didn't hide your head in the sand, but defended the honour of the team valiantly! The enemy had to pay dearly to get the prize.
Stalker Sense
Do you really know, in advance, where the artefact will appear? No matter the cause, you still managed to grab the artefact just seconds after its appearance.
Lucky
Yes, you are lucky... To kill the enemy with your last bullet! Well, better him than you.
Blacklist
One after another, you have killed eight enemies. You shouldn't be afraid of them challenging you for a rematch.
Silent Death
You love to do your job without attracting too much attention, so you are using a silencer. Hey, why should the enemy know where did his killer stand?
Pioneer
You are ready to explore each new appearance in the Zone, and you are usually first to do so. By finding new, unexplored anomalies you have advanced the scientific understanding of the Zone.
Your new data allowed Professors Herman and Ozersk to synthesize a new anabiotic.
Mutant Hunter
You are not trying to avoid dangerous mutants, you're looking for them. Your are a successful hunter, and they are respected among stalkers.
Stalkers are in your debt. \nTo somehow repay you, stalkers will leave ammunition in your personal locker at Yanov from time to time.
Detective

You've uncovered the mystery of stalker disappearances on Skadovsk - mutants were innocent, the real enemy was much more dangerous - your fellow man. Your desire to find the truth earned you respect from stalkers.
Stalkers respect you a great deal. \nOut of respect for you, stalkers will leave medical supplies at your personal locker on Skadovsk, from time to time.
One of the Lads
By not giving Sultan's bandits even a quarter of an inch, you became very popular among stalkers. You are always a welcome guest on the Skadovsk.
You are a stalker idol. \nAfter requests from stalkers, Owl decided to give you a discount. \nBeard offers you the best prices for artefacts.
Kingpin
You aided Sultan in taking the initiative and controlling Beard's business. You are feared and respected at the Creek.
Bandits treat you with respect. \nOwl, fearing that he might be the next victim, will give you a discount. \nBeard must pay you a percentage of his income.
Herald of Justice
You did not let that scoundrel, Soroka, escape justice. A cheat and a fraud, this ruthless coward will now receive just retribution.
Since Soroka was exposed as a fraud, stalkers decided to give his loot to someone more deserving of it. His stuff was placed in your personal box at Yanov.
Seeker
You've found each and every type of artefact known to researchers in the Zone. You've earned the respect of stalkers and attention of bandits.
You are a true stalker. \nBandits will haunt you during your raids in the Zone.
Battle Systems Master
Now, Cardan has a set of tools for every occasion. This allows him to make previously unavailable modifications.
Cardan can now make a unique modification of an exoskeleton: adding amplifiers to the hydraulic actuators.
High Tech Master
Nitro has all tool sets, which is something most technicians in the Zone can only dream of. He can now make high-tech modifications.
Nitro can now make a unique modification of the tactical helmet: an infra-red scanner, which allows you to detect humans in the vicinity.
Skilled Stalker
There are almost no valuable sites in the centre of the Zone that haven't been checked by you already. You've visited almost every local anomaly.
Your experience allows you to find more rare artefacts.
Leader
When faced with the need to work in a team, you've assembled a good squad and proved your leadership skills.
Your leadership skills increase the chances that your team will survive.
Diplomat
You know how to solve problems peacefully. Force is not needed, if everything can be solved with negotiations. Nevertheless, you should beware those who shoot first and ask questions later.
Respecting your ability to negotiate, "Freedom", "Duty", loners and bandits have become more friendly towards you.
Researcher
You've been working with scientists and earned the title of researcher. Now all inhabitants of the research bunker refer to you as their associate.

Recognizing your aid, professor Herman now offers medical supplies and equipment intended only for bunker staff, at regular prices.\nNovikov became so used to you, that when he's making modifications, you only have to pay for the materials, nothing else.
Friend of Duty
You've helped the Duty faction a lot and became famous among its fighters and sympathizers. But do not forget, not everyone likes Duty.

Your relationship with Duty has improved dramatically. If you find yourself in trouble, Dutyers will try to come to your help.
Nitro is a Duty sympathizer and will give you a discount.
Your relations with Freedom deteriorated severely. 
Hawaiian, the trader, is a Freedom sympathizer and has increased prices in response.
Friend of Freedom
You've helped the Duty faction a lot and became famous among its fighters and sympathizers. But do not forget, not everyone likes Freedom.

Your relationship with Freedom has improved dramatically. If you find yourself in trouble, Freedom fighters will try to come to your help.
Nitro is a Duty sympathizer and has increased his prices.
Your relations with Duty deteriorated severely. 
Hawaiian, the trader, is a Freedom sympathizer and gave you a discount.
Balance Advocate
You haven't expressed a preference for any group, and always acted as a free stalker, a loner. As a result, you haven't earned yourself new enemies, but you've also failed to make new friends.
The balance between Freedom and Duty is essential to Yanov's existence. The technician and trader gave you discounts for maintaining it.
Wealthy

Although you're not a stranger to lack of money, you aren't always counting your money and worrying if it's enough. On the contrary, your cash savings are a thing of envy from time to time. And wealthy clients are every merchant's joy...
Merchants often offer you their most rare and expensive items.
Keeper of Secrets
It cannot be denied that you have foresight - you found Strelok's notes in his stashes and did not part with them, until you found their owner.
After receiving the notes, Strelok found a new reason to survive and get to the target at any cost.
Marked by the Zone

You've survived an ejection outside of a shelter, thanks to the anabiotics. This had a mixed impact on your psyche, the most significant being a strange silence. It seems you no longer hear the constant flow of thoughts.
Even without taking drugs you have a chance to survive the release outside of shelter, if you are completely healthy.
Information Dealer

No matter what kind of information ends up in your hands, you will always find a buyer. Without losing the opportunity to deliver the information to interested parties, you also did not forget about your own profit.
Owl gave you a discount, as you're his best informant and ally.
Friend of stalkers

Whenever you found stalkers in trouble, you always helped them. They might not be very organized, but you'll have faithful allies among stalker brethren, who will come to your both in battle and outside of it.
Your relationship with stalkers improved. If you find yourself in trouble, stalkers will try to come to your aid. \nStalker health care professionals have agreed to sell you drugs at a reduced price.
Fearless
You explored all the secrets of the X-8 laboratory, even though it wasn't your primary objective and wasn't required for the operation's success.
Soon, rumors about another laboratory's existence will spread throughout the Zone. \nOut of respect and nostalgia, Cardan will give you a discount on handmade batteries for the Gauss rifle.
